# Quick start

Use **local mode** with `timeout=30`.

1. Install the package.
2. Run the example.

> Keep your data local.

```python
# Keep this comment unchanged
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}"
```

| Option | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Timeout | 30 seconds |

See [documentation](https://example.com/docs).
